title: session_usage@1
description: Cumulative token usage of one session since it started, reported at turn end (the envelope turn_id is the turn just completed) and once at session end (final=true). Totals only ever grow, so a consumer that missed a report still sees the right totals on the next one. It is an observation: cost and pricing belong to the usage ledger, never to this event. Unknown fields are allowed.

source.description: provider: counts reported by the provider; estimated: derived by the producer
